+"""Bind source (customers.csv) to target (customers.db -> customers table).
+
+Source schema (verified):
+    id, name, email, city   -- 1 header row + 3 data rows
+
+Target schema:
+    CREATE TABLE customers (
+        id    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+        name  TEXT,
+        email TEXT,
+        city  TEXT
+    )
+
+Column mapping (identity, by name):
+    csv.id    -> customers.id
+    csv.name  -> customers.name
+    csv.email -> customers.email
+    csv.city  -> customers.city
+Type coercion:
+    id: str -> int  (all other fields stay TEXT)
+"""
+
+import csv
+import sqlite3
+
+CSV_PATH = "customers.csv"
+DB_PATH = "customers.db"
+
+# Target schema definition
+CREATE_TABLE_SQL = """
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customers (
+    id    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+    name  TEXT,
+    email TEXT,
+    city  TEXT
+)
+"""
+
+INSERT_SQL = "INSERT INTO customers (id, name, email, city) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)"
+
+
+def transform_row(row: dict) -> tuple:
+    """Map one CSV record (dict) to the target column tuple."""
+    return (
+        int(row["id"]),      # id: TEXT source -> INTEGER primary key
+        row["name"],         # TEXT (identity)
+        row["email"],        # TEXT (identity)
+        row["city"],         # TEXT (identity)
+    )
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
+    try:
+        conn.execute(CREATE_TABLE_SQL)
+
+        with open(CSV_PATH, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            reader = csv.DictReader(f)
+            rows = [transform_row(r) for r in reader]
+
+        conn.executemany(INSERT_SQL, rows)
+        conn.commit()
+
+        count = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers").fetchone()[0]
+        print(f"Loaded {count} rows into customers table")
+    finally:
+        conn.close()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
